data.desc: Kodiak AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: KDK) is a leader in Physical AI, developing unsupervised autonomous technology designed to power any machine that moves. The core of the company's solution is the Kodiak Driver, a vehicle-agnostic autonomous driving system that combines advanced AI-powered software with modular hardware. Together, they perceive, think and act in the real world. Kodiak's technology is currently deployed by customers in active, real-world operations with no one in the cab. The Kodiak Driver is designed to operate across long-haul trucking, industrial trucking, and defense. Because the same AI system is deployed across multiple applications, experience compounds: progress in one improves Kodiak's Physical AI solution across all of them. Kodiak AI commercializes its technology through Driver-as-a-Service offerings, customer-owned unsupervised autonomous deployments, and strategic partnerships.
